import re, pathlib
# collect template counts in all c files simple
counts={}
for p in pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.c'):
 s=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
 for m in re.finditer(r'(?:static\s+(?:const\s+)?)?struct sc_asn1_entry\s+(c_asn1_\w+)\s*\[([^\]]*)\]\s*=\s*\{',s):
  name=m.group(1); start=m.end(); depth=1; i=start
  while i<len(s) and depth:
   if s[i]=='{': depth+=1
   elif s[i]=='}': depth-=1
   i+=1
  body=s[start:i-1]
  cnt=len(re.findall(r'^\s*\{',body,re.M))
  counts[name]=cnt
# search sc_copy and local declarations nearby
for p in pathlib.Path('src').rglob('*.c'):
 s=p.read_text(errors='ignore')
 for m in re.finditer(r'sc_copy_asn1_entry\((c_asn1_\w+),\s*(\w+)\)', s):
  tmpl,dest=m.groups(); cnt=counts.get(tmpl)
  prefix=s[:m.start()]
  # find declaration of dest before in function/file
  decls=list(re.finditer(r'struct sc_asn1_entry\s+([^;]*\b'+re.escape(dest)+r'\s*\[([^\]]+)\][^;]*);', prefix))
  if decls and cnt:
   decl=decls[-1]; size=decl.group(2).strip()
   try: n=int(size)
   except: continue
   if n<cnt:
    line=s.count('\n',0,m.start())+1
    print(p,line,tmpl,cnt,dest,n, decl.group(0).replace('\n',' '))
